helpers.cm_gcd:
function cm_gcd(a, b)
  a = math.abs(a)
  b = math.abs(b)
  while b ~= 0 do
    a, b = b, a % b
  end
  return a
end
helpers.cm_get:
function cm_get(xs, i)
  if i < 0 or i >= #xs then error('index out of range') end
  return xs[i + 1]
end
helpers.cm_ipow:
function cm_ipow(a, b)
  local r = 1
  while b > 0 do
    if b % 2 == 1 then r = r * a end
    b = b // 2
    if b > 0 then a = a * a end
  end
  return r
end

helpers.cm_modinv:
function cm_modinv(a, m)
  local n = math.abs(m)
  local r0, r1 = a % n, n
  local s0, s1 = 1, 0
  while r1 ~= 0 do
    local q = r0 // r1
    r0, r1 = r1, r0 - q * r1
    s0, s1 = s1, s0 - q * s1
  end
  if r0 ~= 1 then error("base is not invertible") end
  return s0 % n
end
helpers.cm_powmod:
function cm_powmod(a, b, m)
  if b < 0 then
    a = cm_modinv(a, m)
    b = -b
  end
  local r = 1 % m
  a = a % m
  while b > 0 do
    if b % 2 == 1 then r = (r * a) % m end
    a = (a * a) % m
    b = b // 2
  end
  return r
end
helpers.cm_print_list:
function cm_print_list(xs, tag)
  print('l:' .. #xs)
  for i = 1, #xs do
    if tag == 'f' then print('f:' .. string.format('%.17g', xs[i])) else print('i:' .. string.format('%d', xs[i])) end
  end
end
helpers.cm_s_clamp:
function cm_s_clamp(i, n)
  if i < 0 then
    i = i + n
    if i < 0 then i = 0 end
  elseif i > n then
    i = n
  end
  return i
end
helpers.cm_s_cmp:
function cm_s_cmp(a, b)
  local x, y = cm_s_cps(a), cm_s_cps(b)
  for i = 1, math.min(#x, #y) do
    if x[i] ~= y[i] then return x[i] < y[i] and -1 or 1 end
  end
  if #x == #y then return 0 end
  return #x < #y and -1 or 1
end
helpers.cm_s_find:
function cm_s_find(s, sub, start)
  local x, y = cm_s_cps(s), cm_s_cps(sub)
  local n, m = #x, #y
  local i = start
  if i < 0 then
    i = i + n
    if i < 0 then i = 0 end
  end
  if i > n then return -1 end
  while i + m <= n do
    local k = 0
    while k < m and x[i + k + 1] == y[k + 1] do k = k + 1 end
    if k == m then return i end
    i = i + 1
  end
  return -1
end
helpers.cm_s_to_int:
function cm_s_to_int(s)
  local sign, digits = string.match(s, "^[ \t\n\r\v\f]*([+-]?)([0-9]+)[ \t\n\r\v\f]*$")
  if digits == nil then error("not a decimal integer") end
  local v = 0
  for k = 1, #digits do v = v * 10 + (string.byte(digits, k) - 48) end
  if sign == "-" then v = -v end
  return v
end

  xs[i + 1] = v
end
helpers.cm_tanh:
function cm_tanh(x)
  -- Lua has no tanh: a Taylor series near 0 (where exp(2x) - 1 cancels), the exp form elsewhere
  if x ~= x or x == 0 then return x end
  local a = math.abs(x)
  local r
  if a > 20.0 then
    r = 1.0
  elseif a < 0.05 then
    local s = a * a
    r = a * (1.0 + s * (-1.0 / 3.0 + s * (2.0 / 15.0 + s * (-17.0 / 315.0 + s * (62.0 / 2835.0 + s * (-1382.0 / 155925.0))))))
  else
    local t = math.exp(2.0 * a)
    r = (t - 1.0) / (t + 1.0)
  end
  if x < 0 then return -r end
  return r
end
